dedupe_keys.name: geothermal project on tu delft campus del gt 01 core ct scan data

description: TU Delft publishes CT scans of cores recovered from geothermal producer DEL-GT-01. The provider reports approximately 86 metres of recovered core, including a continuous 70-metre sequence covering caprock and upper-reservoir deposits. Preserved one-metre sections were scanned before destructive tests using a Siemens medical CT scanner. The release describes IMA image files and separate acquisition-parameter documentation. Coverage: Coverage is the Delft campus geothermal producer in the Netherlands. The core sections are one metre long; voxel spacing and acquisition dates are not established here. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: Core length and scanner details are provider metadata. No images or acquisition workbook were opened, and image quality was not checked. Simulation uses include geothermal caprock and reservoir characterisation. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
